original_test_intent: Stress BMC management responsiveness for 72 hours under concurrent IPMI OOB, in-band SSH and SOL activity while confirming readable console output, clean diagnostics and final BMC functionality.
original_method: On a dedicated recoverable target, execute an approved rate-limited command/session profile with watchdog and log rotation, capture interval BMC/session/resource/error evidence, and have an operator record KVM/SOL readability at defined checkpoints.
manual_activity: Approve the exact IPMI/IB/SSH/SOL command mix, rates, concurrency, session lifetime, 72-hour window, resource/error limits and abort policy; assign an operator to record KVM readability at specified checkpoints.
required_inputs: Secret-backed credentials and trusted host identity
safety_requirements: Do not use sshpass or command-line passwords
Enforce rate, concurrency, timeout and output limits
Stop on reachability loss, resource/storage threshold, session leak or unexpected diagnostic
Do not power-cycle or auto-retry ambiguity
Verify all sessions and processes terminate
agent_execution_scope: Start bounded OOB, IB/SSH and SOL workloads
Monitor interval reachability, response, sessions, resources and storage
Prompt operator KVM observations at checkpoints
engineer_actions: Provide and approve workload profile and limits
Approve observer schedule and abort policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves the 72-hour concept but is prose rather than a bounded workload contract; it omits rates, interval checks, cleanup and output limits, uses unsafe access assumptions and relies on a final sample that cannot prove continuous health or readability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved bounded IPMI/IB/SSH/SOL profile under a watchdog for 72 hours, record interval machine evidence and operator KVM observations, rotate output safely and stop/clean up under the approved policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 72-hour duration and concurrent management paths remain; the source machine-time value of 720 minutes conflicts with 72 hours and is not substituted for the explicit Procedure duration.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive each management path with independent bounded workers and central watchdog/metrics, while operator checkpoints supply the non-automatable visual evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds rate/concurrency limits, secure access, storage rotation, interval evidence, kill/cleanup controls and explicit visual records instead of an unbounded loop and final-only check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates the approved workload mix and observation cadence; it does not prove all possible command rates, concurrent user patterns or unattended KVM image quality between checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sustained sessions can exhaust BMC resources or evidence storage, and a final healthy state does not exclude temporary outages. Visual readability cannot be inferred from SOL text capture alone.

project_override_considerations: Treat the Procedure's explicit 72 hours as authoritative unless an approved decision changes it; the 720-minute metadata is a source inconsistency to record, not silently reinterpret. Keep KVM and SOL evidence distinct because the criteria names KVM while the procedure opens SOL.
expected_evidence: Approval, target identity and recovery readiness
Exact workload profile, limits and tool versions
Per-interval response rates, latency, errors and timeouts by path
Verified cleanup and final BMC functionality
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires 72 hours while Machine Time is 720 minutes, and Procedure names continuous SOL output while Criteria requires KVM readability. The review preserves the 72-hour Procedure and requires separate SOL machine evidence plus KVM operator observations without rewriting Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workload profile, duration decision, observer coverage and recovery controls are identifiable package/approval inputs, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Transforms an unbounded management flood into a rate-limited, observable 72-hour stress with fail-safe cleanup and preserves the SOL/KVM and duration inconsistencies instead of conflating them.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPMI, SSH and SOL consume different BMC services and session pools, so a combined load needs per-path rates and evidence rather than one undifferentiated loop. Continuous `cat` output can fill storage or hide disconnects unless rotated and monitored. Final `mc info` success cannot prove absence of temporary failures. KVM readability is a rendered visual property, not established by SOL text; operator checkpoints are therefore indispensable. The explicit 72-hour Procedure also cannot be reduced to the 720-minute metadata without an approved decision.
